decision_rule: Choose the unique non-duplicate condition with highest tune success count; ties use lower mean error then lower mean runtime. Keep baseline if no success-count gain. Confirm selected candidate on final with positive success gain and Holm4 p<0.05; otherwise retain baseline. All four comparisons are predeclared; no retuning on final.
threshold_frame: original block pixels before scale; normalize both point sets before MAGSAC
